title: Specialization triples of discrete continuous Galois modules
statement: Let $H$ be a topological group and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Define $\operatorname{TraitSpecialization}(\Lambda,H)$ to be the category of triples $(W,V,a)$, where $W$ is a $\Lambda$-module, $V$ is a discrete continuous $\Lambda$-linear $H$-representation [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], and $a:W\to V$ is an $H$-equivariant linear map when $W$ has trivial $H$-action. A morphism $(W,V,a)\to(W\prime,V\prime,a\prime)$ is a pair of linear maps $(f,g)$ with $g$ equivariant and $g a=a\prime f$. Composition and identities are componentwise. The closed and generic projection functors send a triple to $W$ and $V$, respectively. Its invariant arrow is the same $a$ with codomain restricted to $V^H$.
